title: (Junior) DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor
description: **Junior DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor** **Location:** This is a full-time, permanent and office-based position in Dublin. You must be comfortable working on-site daily. **Salary:** €30,000–€38,000 We are recruiting a DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor to join the workplace health and wellbeing team of a major international organisation in Dublin. This is a permanent, full-time position supporting employees with Display Screen Equipment assessments, workplace ergonomics, reasonable adjustments and wider healthy-working requirements. The role suits someone with hands-on DSE assessment experience in a corporate environment who enjoys working directly with employees to resolve workplace comfort, ergonomic, and accessibility issues. You will work with employees who may require additional support due to musculoskeletal concerns, pregnancy, neurodiversity, disability or other health-related requirements, helping identify appropriate workplace adjustments and practical solutions. **What you’ll be doing:** **You will:** * Conduct individual DSE and Healthy Working Assessments * Carry out assessments for high-risk employees and new and expectant mothers * Support employees requiring workplace enablement or reasonable adjustments * Review workstation setups and identify ergonomic risks or areas for improvement * Recommend appropriate ergonomic equipment, furniture and workplace adjustments * Conduct both face-to-face and video-based assessments * Produce clear, accurate assessment reports and document recommendations * Manage follow-up assessments and individual cases through to resolution * Work with HR, Health & Safety, Office Operations and Technology teams where required * Support employees with more complex health, accessibility or neurodiverse requirements * Assist with the organisation's on-site Accessibility Centre * Deliver employee drop-in sessions and guide healthy working practices * Liaise with specialist external providers where additional support is required * Support employees at Dublin offices and occasionally at other Dublin client locations **What we’re looking for:** Ideally, you will have at least one year of practical experience carrying out DSE or Healthy Working Assessments. **You should have:** * Experience conducting DSE/workstation assessments * A good understanding of workplace ergonomics * Knowledge of ergonomic equipment and furniture * An understanding of workplace Health & Safety requirements * Confidence dealing directly with employees, including individuals with more complex health or accessibility needs * Strong written communication and report-writing skills * Good organisational and case-management skills * Confidence working independently and managing your own appointment schedule * Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Teams and related workplace systems Experience using DSE assessment platforms such as Cardinus would be advantageous. Candidates from Physiotherapy, Occupational Health, Occupational Therapy, Ergonomics or similar backgrounds may also be considered where they can demonstrate relevant workplace assessment experience. **Right to Work:** Applicants must already hold the unrestricted right to work in Ireland. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. **Start Date:** The organisation is looking to appoint as soon as possible, so candidates available at short notice are particularly welcome. If you have experience supporting employees with workplace ergonomics, DSE assessments and healthy-working solutions and would like to join a large international organisation, we would be interested in hearing from you. Contact: Elvis Eckardt

title: Associate Systems Administrator

On Call work may be required with this roll as needed by the business. The Associate Systems Administrator must be able to perform these duties safely and efficiently as part of their responsibilities. **What You'll Do** **System Administration & Support** * Perform daily monitoring, management, and troubleshooting for core corporate enterprise software platforms. * Assist with the configuration, deployment, and maintenance of identity platforms and collaboration tools. * Follow established change management procedures for system updates and modifications. * Maintain accurate system documentation, including runbooks and knowledge base articles for the Service Desk. **Workspace & Endpoint Management** * Support the administration of Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions such as Jamf and Microsoft Intune. * Assist in managing end-user devices, including software deployments, VDI deployment and desktop configurations. * Help implement and enforce security measures like software patches and OS updates. **Networking & Infrastructure** * Provide first-level support for network escalations, including Wi-Fi, VPN, and firewall issues. * Assist with basic network troubleshooting and performance monitoring for EU office environments. * Support the setup and maintenance of local network hardware under senior guidance. **Identity & Security Compliance** * Manage user lifecycles within identity platforms (e.g., Okta) to ensure appropriate access controls. * Contribute to incident response efforts by participating in a regional on-call rotation. * Review incoming IT requests to ensure alignment with company Information Security and governance policies. **What You'll Bring** **Required Skills & Experience** * Foundational experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms such as Okta or OneLogin. * Proficiency working within enterprise ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Atlassian/Jira). * Experience with enterprise collaboration tools including Google Workspace, Microsoft O365, and Slack. * Exposure to MDM tools such as procedures. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Audiovisual (AV) setup and troubleshooting for conference rooms. * Basic administration experience with enterprise cloud-based telephony skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across time zones. The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Position Pay Range €38.000—€48.000 EUR **Working at CarGurus** We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. title: Graduate Health & Safety Consultant & Trainer

Training and Development** * Initially observe and support the delivery of Health & Safety training courses. * Develop the knowledge, confidence and presentation skills required to deliver training independently. * Progress towards delivering Health & Safety training in accordance with FSC's course content and quality standards. * Participate in FSC's food safety training programme and work towards developing food safety training delivery skills. * Maintain accurate training records, assessments and certification documentation. * Contribute to the development and improvement of training materials where required. **5. title: Module Process Engineer
description:
**Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- Intel Ireland is a leading centre for semiconductor manufacturing and technology development, producing advanced process technologies that enable Intel products used around the world. Our teams work in a highly automated, high-volume manufacturing environment, focused on safety, innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. **Responsibilities** / What you'll do: As a Module Process / Equipment Engineer at Intel Ireland, you will support the development and high-volume manufacturing of advanced semiconductor technologies. Working in a fast-paced fab environment, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver safe, stable, and efficient manufacturing processes. In this role, you will: * Support the transfer of new process/automation technologies from Technology Development into High Volume Manufacturing. * Take ownership of module and/or equipment performance, including qualification, monitoring, and continuous improvement. * Help maintain high levels of equipment availability and process performance to meet safety, quality, output, and cost targets. * Support preventative maintenance strategies, troubleshooting activities, and implementation of equipment or process upgrades. * Use data analysis and structured problem-solving methods to identify issues, improve process capability, and reduce variation. * Partner with engineers across process, equipment, manufacturing, quality, and module teams to solve technical challenges and improve operational performance. * Contribute to defect reduction, yield improvement, and manufacturability enhancements. * Assist in driving improvements in safety, productivity, quality, and cost within your assigned area. * Learn, apply, and help sustain best practices across site technologies while developing technical expertise in semiconductor manufacturing. **Qualifications:** ------------------- To be initially considered for this position, **you should have** : * A relevant Bachelor's, Master's, or equivalent qualification in Engineering or Science discipline, such as Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry or a similar technical field. * 0-4 years of relevant work experience. * A strong interest in semiconductor manufacturing, process engineering, or equipment engineering. * Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to identify trends and support decision-making. * Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple disciplines. A proactive approach to learning and continuous improvement in a technical manufacturing environment. **Preferred** qualifications: The following would be an advantage: * Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes or high-volume manufacturing environments. * Experience through internships, university projects, research, or placements in process engineering, equipment engineering, manufacturing, or related technical areas. * Familiarity with statistical analysis, experimental design, or structured problem-solving methodologies. * Experience working with data analysis tools, technical reporting, or process/equipment performance monitoring. * Familiarity with data automation tools or custom scripts used to extract, clean, and analyze manufacturing data (Python, SQL, MATLAB, R, VBA, Shell scripting, BASH) Awareness of safety, quality, and operational excellence principles in an industrial environment. **Job Type:** ------------- College Grad **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (Ireland) **Primary Location:** --------------------- Ireland, Leixlip **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- N/A **EU Salary** ------------- We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. Annual Salary Range for this job which could be performed in Ireland is: €41,000.00 - €77,000.00

The compensation range displayed in this posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for this position. Within this range, individual pay is determined by job related skills, experience, and relevant education, training. As part of our total compensation approach, the final offer may include additional pay components and benefits. Your recruiting team will share the confirmed base salary along with any applicable total compensation elements upon employment offer delivery. **Work Model for this Role** This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. \* Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.

title: Night Support Worker - Emergency Services
description: **About Us:** At Dublin Simon Community, we’re dedicated to making home a reality. We empower individuals to access and sustain housing through services like prevention, addiction treatment, emergency response, and targeted interventions, in collaboration with our partners. If you share our values and want to make a difference, we’d love to hear from you. We’re looking for client-focused, friendly, and adaptable individuals to join our team. We prioritise best practices in HR, including staff training, communication, and involvement in decision-making, to create a supportive and effective work environment. **About The Role** All our emergency services are provided on a low threshold basis with a harm reduction model and a full suite of services for clients. The aim of our emergency services is to support our residents to move on to and to be able to sustain long-term accommodation. We have several measures in place to ensure a quality, wraparound support service is provided to enable people to move out of homelessness. As a Support Worker, you’ll help to meet client needs on a nightly basis; you will provide in-the-moment support and safety to clients. You will contribute to ensuring effective and consistent best-practice standards are followed in the Dublin Simon Community emergency accommodation services. The Support Worker role is an opportunity to gain frontline experience and many support workers graduate on to project worker roles within the organisation. As well as our induction program, you will be provided with 10 training days throughout the year, as well as on-the-job coaching and mentoring, ensuring you have the support and training to succeed in this role. **Contract Type – 3 Vacancies Available** * Permanent * Fixed-Term * Specified Purpose Contract. ***Working Hours*** – 37.5 hours a week, 7 day liability. ***Location*** – Carman's Hall & Harcourt St. Services **Your Responsibilities** * Carry out health and safety checks as per local policy and recording of same. * Provide support to the clients at night, recording on support plans, updating PASS and nights bed list, encouraging sleep hygiene. * Provide care interventions, including daily living skills support, relapse prevention support. * Ensure all new clients receive a robust induction to the service and are aware of their rights and responsibilities. * Ensure building is secure at night and that all systems are working (alarms, CCTV, emergency response details) and adhering to the lone working policy. * Therapeutic and diversionary interventions, providing emotional and motivational support, promoting positive mental health attitudes, self-esteem and self-respect. * Support the manager in the implementation of the strategic and operational action objectives. Taking responsibility for developing and implementing strategic and operational goals. * Preparations of rooms for service user intake to ensure standards are maintained. * Crisis and conflict management. * Ensure consistent handovers, diary, incident reports and follow-ups, in accordance with organisation policies. * Accommodation management; ensuring routine maintenance is carried out, cleaning, security inspections and bedroom health and safety inspections occur, in line with operational procedures and standards. * Ensure neighbourhood policy is implemented and managed at all times. * Active interventions; harm reduction, overdose prevention. * Interpersonal skills development, dealing with relationships, family liaison and behavioural management issues. **Essential For The Role** * Level 6,7,or 8 in a relevant field with 6 months experience in similar setting (including voluntary work and college placement) Or * Level 5 in relevant field with 12 months experience in similar setting (including voluntary work and college placement) * A Passion for helping people. * Flexibility to work in an agile environment. * Willingness to learn. * Experience in carrying out Health & Safety inspections and audits. **Benefits To Working With Dublin Simon Community** * 25 days of annual leave * 5% matched contribution to your pension * Paid Sick Leave Policy * Paid Mat * Maternity Leave Policy * Bike to Work Scheme * Commuter Travel Tax Savers Ticket * 1st-week Comprehensive Training * Progression Opportunities **Please note:** If you are unsure of any of the requirements, please contact the Recruitment Team at (01) 6354860. Shortlisting will continue throughout the recruitment process. Shortlisting may take place while the vacancy is live, so you may be called for interview and/or the vacancy may be filled before the closing date. Dublin Simon Community is an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

title: People & Culture Coordinator
description: **Company Description** The Hoxton has opened its very first hotel in Ireland in the beautiful capital city of Dublin. This coastal city is steeped in history, packed with green parks and brought to life through music, art and the best social eating and drinking. The Hoxton, Dublin is home to 129 bedrooms of varying sizes, a lobby bar & restaurant, a historic bar, Cantina Valentina, our large ground floor restaurant and The Dig - our unique meetings and events space. **Job Description** * You will be the first point of contact for our teams when it comes to general questions and requests, fulfilling a key support role within the people team. * Manage the administration of all core touch points throughout the employee journey. * Manage and maintain our holy grail, the people tracker. * Work with the team on managing our various people platforms. * Support with running various reports from holiday accruals to headcount. * Support the team with recruitment needs, CV pre-screening and telephone screening. * Support talent attraction from advertising on The Hoxton website and local recruitment job boards and keeping our recruitment system up to date. * Play a big part in making sure our newbies have a great joining experience; from arranging their starter paperwork to setting up their tech, helping out with our group inductions and checking they’re settling in well. * Support with related activities such as room set ups, training coordination and bot/poster creation. * Fun-time Friday, get togethers? That’s your domain. You arrange the regular events that everyone looks forward to. * Get involved in the team activities. Qualifications * Individuals. You’re looking for a place where you can be you; no clones in suits here. * Passion for hospitality – whether that’s a drink, a meal, an event or a bed for the night. * You’re all about having a positive impact on the people you interact with, leaving them with a memorable experience. * You’re not precious. We leave our egos at the door and help get things done. * You’re up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once. * If we got stuck in a lift together, we’d have a good time and share a few laughs. * You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other, and has fun along the way. * Previous experience in a human resources role would be fantastic, if you’re already HR qualified or working towards it all the better. * You naturally want to help and support the people around you; others have most likely described you as a ‘people person’ and you’re great at building relationships. * Keen to learn and pick up new things – you have ambitions to progress in the world of HR. * Comfortable with systems/platforms and great with the Microsoft Office Suite. * You are scarily organised, eagle eye for detail, have the ability to multi-task and spin a million plates in the air at one time, prioritise and re-prioritise as things come in. Additional Information **What's In It For You...** * Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences. * Competitive salary. * 30 days holiday (including bank holidays), pension and life insurance. * Food on us during your shift. * Enjoy a free night at The Hoxton and a meal for two when you first start with us. * Training to get you settled into your role with ongoing development that helps you think, make and thrive to set you up for success at work. * Time off to volunteer with one of our partner charities. * Hox Hero and Nifty Fifty, our rewards for going the extra mile and living our values. * An annual diversity and inclusion calendar of events creating opportunities for you to learn, celebrate and make a positive impact. * Regular team get togethers, from our High Fives to our (pretty special!) team parties – we know how to have a good time! * The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding. * Join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that is shaking things up on the hospitality scene. * Excellent discounts across The Hoxton and the global Ennismore family.

title: EUV International System Install Engineer

Become an International Upgrade, Install and Relocation Engineer at ASML to build and test some of the most amazing, complex machines that you’ll ever see! This means a lot of travelling (70-80%) for long periods (4 - 6 weeks) of time, continuous learning, and being surrounded by many diverse cultures and environments. Do you take on this life-changing opportunity? As this role is the perfect start to your long-lasting ASML career, many other departments crave your expertise once you have gained experience in this role. Additionally, you get the opportunity to learn from deeply knowledgeable colleagues whilst encountering new challenges every day. EUV represents a big leap forward in semiconductor manufacturing, enabling our customers to create even more powerful and more efficient chips. This team will be based in Ireland as part of the EU EUV UIR department and will focus on flying out to customer sites around the world and supporting in the EU region. The team will primarily perform reinstalls but also other UIR (upgrade, install and relocation) activities as per business needs. **Role and responsibilities** To be able to transfer a fully tested and qualified lithography machine at our client’s site, you will be cross trained in multiple activities within a unique cleanroom environment. Besides that, as an International UIR System Reinstall Engineer you will: * Work in accordance with the installation sequence and installation procedures; * Work in day-night shift schedule (12-hour rotations) at customer sites around the world; * Perform tests (calibrations and system qualification) to ensure equipment qualification; * Troubleshoot and solve system failures and demonstrate self-reliance in challenging situations; * Take ownership, lead a shift to deliver quality; * Manage technical escalations; * Contribute to the improvement loop of our lithography machines and processes; * Represent ASML at the customer site in a professional way; * When not working abroad, the engineer is expected to assist local customers. **Education and experience** To help us tackle the technical challenges we face, you need: * Bachelor or Master’s degree in a technical discipline (preferably mechanical, aerospace, electronic, mechatronics engineering); * Knowledge of mechanics, pneumatics, hydraulics, vacuum systems; * Practical hands-on experience gained through previous work, projects, labs, internships, or student teams (e.g. assembly, prototyping, troubleshooting); * A valid driver’s license; * Legally authorized to access controlled technology as defined in Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. * 730 et seq.). **Skills** Working at the cutting edge of tech, you always have new challenges and problems to solve. Being creative and working together is the only way to do that. To further thrive as an International UIR Engineer, you will need the following skills: * Safety‑first mindset; * Flexibility. Spending 70 – 80% of your time travelling around the world and working in flexible shift patterns at customer sites, sometimes at short notice; * Adaptable and resilient under pressure, with flexibility to work in different schedules and environments; * Clear and effective communication skills, with focus on reporting, knowledge sharing, influencing, and supporting; * Quality‑driven (“first time right”); * Passion for hands‑on engineering challenges; * Being open-minded, team player and be able to use your own initiative (self-sufficient); * Awareness of cultural differences and ability to collaborate in diverse international environments. **Other Information** We only consider candidates who have uploaded an updated version of their CV and a cover letter stating their motivation to apply for this specific role at ASML. (Please take some time to really think about your cover letter, as this is the perfect opportunity to present yourself for our Hiring Managers). Please be advised, for this role we require candidate with a valid international driver’s license. Travel is estimated to be around 75%. This percentage is an estimate and can be revisited in mutual agreement. The home location will be Leixlip, Ireland. Main locations for travel are supporting worldwide, Israel and the in the European Union. (Re)installations/other UIR activities will be supported on all EUV customer sites worldwide. Candidate should be able to travel to the EU with no barriers (next day travel) and should have the ability to get proper visa to other locations when required. The job content is in transition and it is required that the employee is comfortable with a dynamic and changing environment. It is expected that you are open-minded, show initiative and join us to thrive in our new identity. This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. * 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. *This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the* *United States* Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. * 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. **Inclusion and diversity** ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company. Need to know more about applying for a job at ASML? Read our frequently asked questions.

title: Education Partnerships Coordinator
description: Who we are **About Stripe** Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. **About The Team** Stripe’s Education Partnerships team creates meaningful learning and engagement opportunities for students. We collaborate with educational institutions and community partners to design experiences that welcome students and help them explore future possibilities. The team plans and delivers education initiatives and events of varying sizes, including the Stripe Young Scientist and Technology Exhibition (YSTE), University of Limerick’s Immersive Software Engineering (UL ISE), and Irish Mathematical Trust (IMT). What you’ll do As an Education Partnerships Coordinator, you’ll help bring Stripe’s education events and initiatives to life. You’ll work closely with the program lead and internal and external partners to design student experiences, coordinate events, and ensure that participants feel welcomed and supported. This role offers the opportunity to build expertise in education programming and event delivery while gradually taking on more complex projects and responsibilities. **Responsibilities** * Create and project manage meaningful experiences for the student community through events and other engagement activities * Partner with the programs lead to design the student experience and deliver large-scale events * Welcome students, provide clear guidance, and help ensure that their experiences run smoothly * Coordinate event logistics, schedules, materials, communications, and other operational details * Support Stripe’s existing education events and partnerships, including YSTE, UL ISE, and IMT events * Develop a thorough understanding of Stripe’s education initiatives and take ownership of increasingly complex responsibilities over time Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. **Minimum Requirements** * Experience coordinating events, programs, community activities, or comparable projects * Ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and logistical details in a changing environment * Clear and thoughtful written and verbal communication skills * A welcoming and service-oriented approach to working with students, partners, and colleagues * Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external organisations **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting education, student, early-career, or community programs * Experience coordinating large-scale or multi-partner events * Interest in learning about education partnerships and developing broader program-management responsibilities In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €57,000 - €85,400. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now Please find our EU applicant personal information notice here.

title: FY27 Intern Opportunities
description: Are you a problem solver looking for a hands-on internship position with a market-leading company that will help develop your career and reward you intellectually and professionally? **About Analog Devices** Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X. At ADI, you will learn from the brightest minds who are here to help you grow and succeed. During your internship, you will make an impact through work on meaningful projects alongside a team of experts. Collaborating with colleagues in an environment of respect and responsibility, you will create connections that will become a part of your professional network. ADI’s culture values aligned goals, work-life balance, continuous and life-long learning opportunities, and shared rewards. The internship program features various lunch-and-learn topics and social events with other interns and full-time employees. At ADI, our goal is to develop our interns so they are the first to be considered for full-time roles. Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible. **Location: Limerick/Cork/Dublin, Ireland** **Are you looking to work for a company that is a leader in technology that makes the world smarter, safer, healthier and greener? If so, then Analog Devices International is the destination for you** **Leading Edge Technology;** From digital healthcare to 5G connectivity, from autonomous and electric vehicles to the digitised factory, Analog Devices is passionate about turning tomorrow's possibilities into reality, making the world smarter, safer, healthier and greener. Wherever digital meets physical we’re there. Virtually every wireless call, text, and download today passes through an Analog Devices IC. Our automotive battery monitoring technology is used in the majority of petrol and diesel engine cars with engine start-stop functionality. This helped prevent 33 million metric tons of carbon vehicle emissions last year globally, which is more than half of all the carbon emissions the whole of Ireland produces in a single year. In digital x-ray imaging our technology enables delivery of increasingly high image fidelity at lower radiation dosages. Because we are dedicated to solving the toughest engineering challenges, Analog Devices is one of the top 10 semiconductor companies in the world. **We don’t just talk about innovation, we live it** ; At ADI, we believe that work should be exciting and meaningful. We encourage initiative and creativity, and we actively support the free exchange of ideas. A career with ADI means taking part in innovation and being challenged to achieve, and it offers the opportunity to work with other talented people, using state-of-the art processes and equipment. We run an annual Innovation Award for our Co-ops, a Global Early Employee Challenge for recent grads, and Hackathons for our wider community of employees. At ADI we strive to be *Ahead of What’s Possible* . **Silicon Meets Software;** Software development at ADI spans from edge nodes to generating insights in the cloud – and everything in between. Working with hardware teams, your software skills in planning, systems architecture, designing, developing, troubleshooting, debugging, and testing can help to unlock the potential of our algorithms, technology platforms, and systems to make a real-world impact. Areas where our hardware and software technologies combine to offer real-world, system solutions include IoT smart building applications, automotive radar systems for autonomous driving and collision avoidance, vital signs monitoring in the healthcare space, and 5G communications infrastructure. As ADI continues to grow its software capability, we’re also focussed on building expertise in Machine Learning and AI. We’re looking to hire people who want to make science fiction real. **One Company, Unlimited Opportunity;** The scale of Analog Devices and the range of technologies we develop, markets we serve, countries we operate in, and skills that we utilise, makes for an exciting opportunity for you to find your direction. The opportunities for you at ADI are endless and we actively encourage you to explore those opportunities. From our Graduate Rotation Program to our Continuing Education policies, to how we actively encourage internal mobility, ADI helps you to plot your path to success. **What's the secret to our success? It's very simple – we treat our employees as our greatest asset.** **Role Description** Analog Devices offers full-time paid placement opportunities to 70+ students each year across a wide range of functions and disciplines. As a placement student, you will have the opportunity to work with our talented teams of engineers on very challenging work assignments. You will play an integral part in the development of our products. To be eligible for the placement program, you must be currently enrolled in 3rd level education. We hire predominantly from Electronics, Software, and Computer Science disciplines but also from Physics, Maths, Chemistry, Business, Economics, Environmental Science etc. into many different roles which include IC Design, Product Applications, Systems Applications, Test Development, Design Evaluation, Central Applications, Software Development, Packaging, Embedded Software, Reliability, Failure Analysis, Process Development, Finance, Purchasing, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Environmental Health and Safety etc. As a valued team member, students at ADI are assigned real work projects that are both meaningful and exciting. Our experienced engineers take their roles as mentors seriously as they want to see you succeed. Your short-term experience at ADI just might be the launch of a long-term career. At ADI we view your time on placement student as an extended interview. You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your abilities and learn more about ADI, while we have an opportunity to assess your potential and consider you for full-time opportunities after graduation. At the conclusion of your placement, we will have a much better understanding of that potential and we hope that you will have decided that ADI is the place for you to start your career. **Why Join ADI?** * Competitive Salary, plus relocation assistance * Competitive Holiday Allowance * Learning Opportunities/ Access to Cutting Edge Technology * Placement Specific Initiatives -Ted Talks, College Ambassador etc. * Variety of Networks and Sports & Social Clubs * Subsidised Canteen and Free Tea and Coffee Stations * Onsite Occupational Health Clinic * Cutting edge facilities in our European Research & Design Centre We will be recruiting for Co-op positions from August/September 2026. Your Co-op term will be aligned to your college assigned Co-op schedule. *For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.* *Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.* Job Req Type: Internship/Cooperative Required Travel: No

title: Field SDR
description: At Flipdish, we’re turning the tables in favour of independent restaurant and takeaway owners by offering them powerful, simple-to-use tech solutions backed by real human support. Everything we do is designed to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple in a world that’s anything but. **About The Role** You’ll join the Field Sales team working across the assigned Ireland territory, supporting Flipdish’s mission to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple. You’ll partner closely with Field Sales Account Executives, Sales Leadership, and Marketing to generate qualified opportunities, build pipeline, and create strong handoffs that support long-term customer growth. Success in this role looks like building a healthy pipeline of qualified meetings, consistently converting outreach into booked opportunities, and being a trusted first point of contact for prospective customers in your territory. What you’ll own * Prospect restaurants and takeaway businesses within your assigned territory to build a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities. * Use a mix of field visits, phone calls, email, and social outreach to engage prospects and create interest. * Qualify inbound and outbound leads and book meetings or product demonstrations for Field Sales Account Executives. * Manage territory coverage by planning visits to target accounts and attending relevant local networking events, trade shows, and business gatherings. * Maintain accurate CRM records, tracking outreach, lead quality, meeting activity, and conversion performance. * Partner with Field Sales Account Executives to improve outreach strategy, messaging, and handoff quality. * Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working. Constructive challenge is a responsibility — prioritising harmony over truth or progress is a failure of responsibility. What success looks like * A steady flow of qualified meetings and opportunities created from your outreach and territory activity. * Strong conversion from prospecting activity to booked meetings and sales handoffs. * High-quality CRM hygiene and reliable reporting on pipeline and activity. * Effective collaboration with Account Executives that improves follow-up, conversion, and customer experience. * Increased territory penetration through consistent, disciplined field execution. **About You** You’ll thrive in this role if you: * Have strong interpersonal and communication skills. * Can work independently, manage time well, and stay organised across a busy territory. * Are comfortable prospecting through phone, email, social outreach, and in-person meetings. * Bring resilience, energy, and a growth mindset. * Are confident handling rejection and staying motivated in a fast-paced sales environment. * Are familiar with CRM systems and sales tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar. **The Following Would Help You Stand Out** * Entry-level sales experience, or equivalent practical experience in a customer-facing role. * Experience in the restaurant, hospitality, or hospitality-tech sector. * Familiarity with the sales process and engaging decision-makers. * Willingness to travel within your assigned territory. What you get We’re a growing startup and we understand that amazing incentives will attract amazing talent. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer unparalleled opportunities for career growth. If you’re smart, ambitious, and hard-working, we’ll do whatever it takes to make you a Flipdisher! * Hub model (hybrid): a healthy blend of hub + home working, with time in our Sandyford office * Time off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays + company days * Private healthcare: IE cover provided through Laya Healthcare * Pension: retirement savings support in Ireland * Team connection: regular team meet-ups and company events Interview process Here’s what you can expect throughout the interview process. * Recruiter screening call (15 minutes) * Hiring manager interview (45 - 60 minutes) * Hiring manager interview (45 - 60 minutes) * Competency / technical stage * Reference checks Our Culture At Flipdish, we’re on the side of independent restaurant and takeaway owners, running busy operations on tight margins with rising costs, staffing challenges, and an increasingly demanding customer base. Our job is to make their lives easier with technology that’s powerful, satisfyingly simple, and backed by real human support. Our integrated ecosystem, spanning online ordering, marketing, loyalty, point of sale, menu optimisation, and operational automation, helps restaurants grow while staying in control. We’re an AI-first company, and we use it to help our customers get better outcomes, faster ordering, smarter marketing, and smoother operations, so owners and teams can spend more time on what matters. Inside the company, we value ownership and clarity, with a friendly, people-led culture behind it. We trust our people to help shape what kind of employer Flipdish is, not just follow a script. Transparency is huge for us: we listen to each other, and create the space for people to grow, with balance not burnout. We’re focused on impact and team energy, not “being seen”. You’ll have meaningful scope, work closely with smart people across teams, and be trusted to make things better as Flipdish scales. If you’d like to read more about interviewing at Flipdish, please check out our Interviewing at Flipdish guide.

title: Full-time Educator | DUBLIN| November - January
description: **Requirements** **Description & Requirements** **Who We Are:** lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people. **Job Summary** The Educator role is the foundation of our success as an organization. Educators are experts in creating world-class customer service, or guest experience, in our retail stores. They are responsible for engaging and connecting with our guests, sharing top-quality product education, and speaking authentically about our community and culture. **Key Responsibilities Of The Job** **Guest (i.e., Customer) Experience** * Interact with guests to ensure a great guest experience in a manner that values guests’ time. * Assess guests’ needs to provide customized, effective purchase and return solutions and support. * Provide technical product education by articulating the value and benefit of the product. * Facilitate a seamless end-to-end guest experience by conducting accurate and timely guest transactions and executing market-relevant omnichannel programs (e.g., buy online/pickup in store, phone sales, and ship from store options) according to company standards. * Move dynamically on the floor to continuously engage with guests and attend to guest or store needs. * Receive guest feedback and partner with store leadership to take appropriate action and “make it right” for guests. **Working With Others** * Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment by welcoming and celebrating differences to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests. * Establish supportive and productive relationships with all team members. * Collaborate with team members to ensure optimal guest experience and support store operations. **Operations** * Perform product presentation tasks (e.g., put items back in place, restock or add depleted items to the floor from inventory, destock or relocate items) according to company standards. * Use in-store technology to support store operations and provide positive guest experiences. * Perform cleaning tasks as needed throughout the shift to maintain the luxury environment of the store. * Understand and adhere to people safety policies and procedures to maintain a safe work environment. * Perform work in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and laws or regulations. **Key Skills & Core Values You Bring** * Inclusion & Diversity: Creates/supports an inclusive environment that values/celebrates differences * Integrity/Honesty: Behaves in an honest, fair, and ethical manner * Guest Experience: Enjoys working and connecting with, understanding, and helping guests * Personal Responsibility: Accepts responsibility/accountability for actions; is dependable * Self-Awareness: Is aware of how words or actions may be perceived by or affect others * Collaboration and Teamwork: Works productively with others to achieve goals; seeks diverse perspectives * Enthusiasm: Is enthusiastic about one’s own work; looks for ways to make work fun and engaging **Job Requirements** **Eligibility** * Must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the store is located * Must be 18 years of age or older * Must have proof of the Right to Work and evidence relating to associated local legislative requirements (EMEA only) * Must have the ability to travel to assigned store with own transportation methods **Availability** * Willing to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays **Other Willingness Requirements** * Willing to work in an environment with bright lights and loud music * Willing to move through a store for most of a shift to help guests and accomplish work * Willing to move boxes weighing up to 30 lbs (13.6 kg) * Willing to work as part of a team and also complete some work independently **Job Assets (i.e., nice to have; not required)** * Education: High school diploma, GED, or equivalent In keeping with our mission, please connect with us at accommodations@lululemon.com if you have questions about how your unique abilities may translate to the requirements for this role, with or without a reasonable accommodation. In your email, please include the position title, the location of the position and the nature of your question or request. **Beyond The Paycheck (Benefits & Perks)** At lululemon, we care for and invest in the whole person – body, mind, spirit. Our total rewards program is designed to support you in achieving your goals and focus on the things you love. In addition to competitive base pay and a team-based bonus program, we also offer extended health plans, paid time off, savings plans, generous employee discounts, fitness/yoga classes, parenthood top up program and personal and professional development programs. Note: availability of these benefits and perks may be subject to your location & employment type and may have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these benefits and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.

title: HR Business Partner
description: **HR Business Partner** **Dublin | Permanent** *Our standard working hours for this role are 36.25 hours per week, 9am-5:30pm Monday to Friday. We operate a three days in the office, two days from home working model. As an inclusive employer, we are willing to consider flexible working requests.* **Exceptional by design. A career where you can shape the people agenda.** **The opportunity** Join a team where your expertise truly matters. Pinsent Masons is looking for an experienced HR Business Partner to provide proactive, high-quality and commercially focused HR support across our Dublin office. This is a standalone role with broad responsibility across the full employee lifecycle. Working closely with the Head of HR, EMEA, the International HR Business Partner and the Dublin leadership team, you will build influential relationships and provide coaching, guidance and support on a wide range of people matters. You will become a trusted adviser to Partners and senior stakeholders, bringing the credibility and confidence to influence decisions, provide constructive challenge and lead conversations on complex people matters. This is also a genuinely hands-on opportunity, requiring someone who is comfortable combining strategic thinking with the practical delivery of day-to-day HR activity. At Pinsent Masons, your career is exceptional by design, intentionally shaped to support high performance, meaningful development and long-term progression. **What you’ll do** Bring your experience to the table and play a key role in the success of our firm, building trusted relationships and delivering meaningful impact, including: * Act as a trusted adviser to the Dublin leadership team, Partners and managers, attending relevant leadership meetings and leading the local HR agenda. * Manage employee relations matters, including performance, absence, flexible working, grievance, disciplinary and conduct cases, ensuring compliance with Irish employment legislation. * Lead the local delivery of annual HR processes, including performance reviews, salary reviews, promotions, talent planning and career mapping. * Oversee key employee lifecycle activity, including recruitment, onboarding, induction, benefits, payroll notifications and employment changes, working closely with central teams and HR Shared Services. * Support trainees and early talent programmes, including graduate recruitment, internships, assessment centres, trainee development and the completion of relevant Irish Law Society processes. * Use your commercial awareness and knowledge of the local market to identify people trends, improve processes and support wider initiatives across talent development, wellbeing, diversity, equity and inclusion. **What you’ll bring** To thrive in this role, you'll need to bring: * Significant HR Business Partnering experience, ideally gained within a law firm, legal business or wider professional services environment. * Strong knowledge of Irish employment legislation and confidence managing complex employee relations matters. * A sound understanding of the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance, talent, reward, benefits and payroll processes. * The credibility and gravitas to influence and constructively challenge Partners and senior leaders, including during sensitive or difficult conversations. * The ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational delivery, maintaining attention to detail without losing sight of wider commercial priorities. * Excellent communication, relationship management, organisation and prioritisation skills, together with the ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a wider international team. **Why Pinsent Masons** Our “exceptional by design” approach means we’ve deliberately shaped a firm where you can do your best work. We combine meaningful work, clear expectations and the support to build a career that works for you. Why join us? * **Meaningful work, real impact** – the opportunity to contribute to initiatives and projects that have a genuine impact on our clients and the success of a leading international law firm. * **A firm that backs your growt** h – clear expectations, structured development and real investment in helping you reach your potential. * **A progressive culture** – collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking, with the space to innovate and do your best work. Our benefits package reflects our determination to support our people in achieving their full potential. You know what’s important to you and that’s why we offer flexible benefits where we can, allowing you to choose what matters most. Amongst our benefits are: * 25 days holiday * Bonus Scheme * Pension Scheme * Enhanced Family Leave policies * Private Medical Insurance * Health, lifestyle and wellbeing benefits **What happens next?** Once your application has been submitted and reviewed, our Talent Acquisition team will share the outcome with you by email. The selection process is expected to include an initial virtual interview with members of the HR team, followed by a second virtual interview with senior stakeholders. Shortlisted candidates will then be invited to an informal in-person meeting in our Dublin office. We strive to remain flexible depending on the requirements of the role or the candidate. **Our commitment** At Pinsent Masons, we are committed to recruiting and retaining the best talent and building an inclusive and fair workplace. We value the strength that comes from different experiences and strive to create an environment where everyone feels they belong. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and are dedicated to ensuring equitable opportunities throughout our recruitment processes. In line with local laws and cultural contexts across the jurisdictions in which we operate, we encourage people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences to apply. If you need reasonable adjustments or accommodations to participate in our recruitment process or to perform the role, please tell us. We will work with you to identify a suitable approach. #LI-BONF

title: Junior Cloud Engineer (Entry-Level)
description: **Job Description** We are seeking a motivated Junior Cloud Engineer to support cloud infrastructure, deployment and maintenance activities. This role is suitable for graduates looking to start a career in cloud computing and infrastructure technologies. **Key Responsibilities:** * Assist in managing and monitoring cloud infrastructure. * Support cloud deployments and configuration activities. * Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud. * Assist with troubleshooting cloud-related issues. * Support infrastructure monitoring, security and documentation. **Requirements:** * Degree in Computer Science, IT or a related technical discipline. * Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts. * Familiarity with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud is beneficial. * Understanding of networking, operating systems and virtualisation. * Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn. **Experience:** Open to recent graduates and entry-level candidates. **Important:** We do not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the legal right to work.

title: Junior Credit Controller
description: Barden is delighted to partner with successful and growing business in Dublin as they look to hire a Junior Credit Controller. This is a great first step into finance, with proper training and a clear route to grow within the team. You will support the credit control team in collecting payments, answering customer queries, and keeping accounts up to date. You will learn the full order-to-cash cycle from people who have done the job for years. “We are looking for someone with a good head for detail and a friendly phone manner. We will teach the rest.” Hiring Manager **ABOUT THE ROLE** * Support the team in chasing overdue invoices by phone and email. * Respond to customer billing queries and pass on anything complex. * Allocate payments and keep customer accounts accurate. * Help prepare ageing reports and month-end tasks. * Learn credit checks and credit limit reviews from senior colleagues. **ABOUT THE PERSON** * 0 to 2 years in finance, accounts receivable, or credit control. * Clear, confident communicator who is comfortable on the phone. * Good Excel skills and a willingness to learn a new ERP system. * Organised, accurate, and good with detail. title: QC Analyst
description: **Company Description** **Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.** **Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.** **Eurofins PSS Insourcing Solutions® is a global, award-winning insourcing solution. We ensure a strategic, long-term service commitment that delivers value directly at the client’ site, utilising their facilities, equipment, and methodologies, while maintaining the same service, expertise, and cGMP compliance available at the Eurofins facility. Join us in a world where excellence knows no boundaries!** **We’re proud to be an armed forces-friendly place to work and welcome applications from reservists, armed forces veterans (including the wounded, injured and sick), as well as cadet instructors, and military spouses and partners.** **If you want to continue to help make our world a safer and healthier place, then apply for the role below and become a part of the extraordinary Eurofins network.** **Job Description** **Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.** **This is a full time, 12 Month Fixed Term Contract. Working a 39 hour week, Monday – Thursday 08:00 – 16:30, Friday 08:00 – 15:30.** As a QC Analyst you will serve in a cross functional team to support the Bioassay Quality Control testing function, ensuring compliance with cGMP. **Job Responsibilities** * You will perform water testing analyses including Appearance, Nitrates, Total Organic Carbon (TOC) and Conductivity testing, while carrying out laboratory sampling activities and ensuring all work is completed in line with GMP and quality requirements. * You will maintain the smooth operation of the laboratory through data review, equipment checks, laboratory housekeeping, stock and inventory management, waste disposal, and accurate documentation in accordance with client policies and procedures. * You will review analytical data for GMP compliance, support deviation investigations with technical expertise, contribute to problem solving activities, and assist in the preparation and review of protocols, reports, SOPs and other laboratory documentation. * You will collaborate closely with client project teams and colleagues, providing daily updates, building strong working relationships, supporting customer requirements, and delivering high levels of service with a focus on quality, compliance and ethical standards. * You will work independently and as part of the Eurofins team to identify solutions, adapt to changing priorities, provide cover and support for colleagues, train team members where appropriate, and quickly learn new processes and techniques. * You will drive continuous improvement by title: QC Technician
description: Quality in manufacturing is not just about completing checks. It is about knowing when something is right, recognising when it is not, and taking action. We are looking for a QC Technician to join our Quality team at WaterWipes in Drogheda. This is a hands-on role working closely with Production and Engineering to make sure our products, materials and processes meet the standards we expect. This is an onsite role working a 3-cycle shift pattern. The Opportunity As QC Technician, you will be part of the day-to-day operation of our manufacturing site, completing quality checks, analytical testing and product inspections that directly influence whether product and materials can be used or released. The role covers water batching and testing, microbiological sampling, equipment calibration, in-process quality checks, GMP compliance and the management of non-conforming or quarantined product. You will need to be comfortable making decisions based on what the data and inspections tell you, escalating issues quickly and working with colleagues across Production, Engineering and Quality to resolve problems. What You’ll Be Accountable For **You Will** * Batch and test water to support production requirements, including analytical and chemical testing and microbiological sampling using aseptic techniques. * Complete start-up, calibration, metal detector and routine QC checks, making clear decisions based on results. * Carry out in-process checks to confirm products are meeting specification and take appropriate action when they are not. * Identify, isolate and document non-conformances, supporting root cause analysis and CAPA follow-up with internal teams and suppliers. * Quarantine defective or potentially defective finished product and raw materials, maintaining accurate records and full traceability. * Monitor GMP standards and complete routine GMP, Glass and Perspex audits. * Maintain accurate, timely quality records and follow SOPs, SSOWs and site procedures. * Communicate quality issues clearly to Production and Engineering and help train production colleagues on required quality checks. * Support external audits, accreditations, NPD trials and pilot production runs. * Maintain high standards of safety, compliance and organisation within your work areas. Who This Role Is For This role will suit someone who enjoys being close to the manufacturing process and takes pride in getting the detail right. Previous experience in a quality environment or FMCG manufacturing would be valuable. The existing role profile highlights around two years of quality experience and/or internal quality training as desirable rather than essential, so we are also interested in people who have developed relevant quality experience internally and are ready to step up. **You Should Have** * A good working knowledge of GMP and the importance of following defined procedures. * Experience working with SOPs in a manufacturing or quality-controlled environment. * Confidence using Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint. * Previous FMCG quality experience would be an advantage. What Will Make You Successful Here You will do well in this role if you are practical, observant and prepared to take ownership. You notice when something does not look right and investigate rather than overlook it. You can learn technical processes and apply them consistently, while also using good judgement when a decision needs to be made. You will also need strong attention to detail, clear written and verbal communication, good prioritisation and time management, and the ability to work effectively as part of a wider team. Above all, we are looking for someone who understands that good quality decisions matter and is comfortable taking responsibility for them. Why Join WaterWipes At WaterWipes, Quality is part of how we operate, not something we check at the end. As a QC Technician, you will have a role where your decisions have a visible impact on what happens on the production floor. You will work across Quality, Production and Engineering, gain exposure to different parts of the manufacturing operation and contribute to trials, improvement activity and audit readiness. It is a role for someone who wants to build practical quality experience while being trusted to take ownership of the standards they are responsible for. Location & Practicalities **Location:** WaterWipes, Drogheda, Co. Louth **Working arrangement:** Onsite **Shift pattern:** **3-cycle shift-based role** Because this role supports live manufacturing operations, flexibility and reliable attendance across the 3-cycle shift pattern are important. Call to Action If you have quality or manufacturing experience, strong attention to detail and the confidence to make decisions when something does not meet the required standard, we would like to hear from you. Apply to join WaterWipes as our next QC Technician. WaterWipes® was created by our founder Edward McCloskey after his newborn daughter developed a nappy rash on her sensitive skin. After an extensive search he couldn’t find a baby wipe that didn’t contain numerous ingredients, so he decided to make his own. Many years later and after a lot of hard work, testing, and scientific research, WaterWipes® was born. Pure and gentle for the most delicate skin but in the convenience of a baby wipe, WaterWipes® are purer than cotton wool and water. Every day, parents around the world are discovering the benefits of our gentle and effective WaterWipes® for their baby’s skin. We hope you like them too.

title: Systems Analyst, SaaS Operations Onboarding
description: Role summary : The Onboarding Analyst implements and transitions Charles River IMS environments for new SaaS clients. The role combines technical delivery, client coordination, production readiness, issue resolution and operational handover across DEV, UAT and PROD environments. **Purpose and scope** Working within the CRD SaaS Onboarding team, the analyst owns assigned onboarding activities from environment setup through go-live and transition to operations. The role works closely with Professional Services, clients, Infrastructure, NetOps, Database, SaaS Operations, Engineering and third-party vendors. It requires hands-on technical capability, clear stakeholder communication, disciplined governance and sound judgement when escalating delivery or production risks. ****Key Responsibilities:**** * Plan and execute onboarding activities for new clients and new environments, maintaining clear ownership, dependencies, risks and target dates. * Coordinate environment readiness across DEV, UAT and PROD, including infrastructure, application configuration, access, monitoring, capacity and production-readiness checks. * Work with client and internal network teams to establish and validate connectivity, firewall rules, peering, endpoints, certificates and third-party integrations. * Set up and validate interfaces and messaging components such as FIX, IBM MQ, Kafka, file transfer and vendor connectivity, including Bloomberg, Omgeo and Cassini where applicable. * Install and configure Charles River IMS components; deploy patches, hotfixes, plug-ins and add-ons through approved CI/CD and Azure DevOps pipelines. * Design, build and validate complex BOD/EOD batch schedules and operational jobs; support Tidal or equivalent enterprise job-scheduling technologies. * Perform troubleshooting across applications, Windows/Linux services, databases, APIs, authentication, networks and integration flows; coordinate resolution with the correct resolver teams. * Prepare and execute Disaster Recovery tests, document outcomes and close identified gaps before production acceptance. * Support UAT, implementation weekends and go-live activities, including occasional out-of-hours coverage and disciplined handover to support teams. * Maintain accurate documentation, knowledge articles, runbooks, configuration records, open-issue lists and decision logs; identify and implement process improvements. * Manage client and service-partner communications, monitor satisfaction, and escalate material risks or blockers to senior management using sound judgement. ****Required Competencies And Experience**** * 1-5 years of experience supporting or implementing mission-critical production software, preferably within financial services, investment management or a SaaS environment. Open to recent graduates and early- career professionals. * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, including data investigation, basic performance diagnosis and safe execution of operational queries. * Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Python, Windows Batch or a comparable language. * Practical understanding of Microsoft Azure or AWS infrastructure, networking, security, compute, storage, monitoring and high-availability concepts. * Experience with enterprise job scheduling, software installation, configuration management, release deployment and incident/problem resolution. * Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear actions, risks and decisions for clients and internal stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple workstreams, follow controlled processes and produce reliable documentation in a high-growth, time-sensitive environment. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. ****Preferred Knowledge**** * Applications and domain: Charles River IMS; trade order management; middle-office, back-office or other financial applications; investment-management workflows. * Platforms and operations: Windows/Linux servers; Azure DevOps; CI/CD; monitoring; databases; clusters/high availability; DR/BCP; production support. * Integration and connectivity: FIX; APIs; gRPC; IBM MQ; Kafka; SFTP/file transfer; LDAP/SSO; certificates; vendor and client network connectivity. * Delivery behaviours: Client focus; ownership; structured troubleshooting; accurate status reporting; risk escalation; collaboration; continuous improvement. **Success measures** * Environments and integrations are delivered to agreed scope and readiness dates with no avoidable production defects. * Risks, dependencies and issues are visible, owned and escalated early, with accurate stakeholder reporting. * Batch, interface, DR, monitoring and operational handover evidence is complete before go-live approval. * Knowledge articles and runbooks are reusable, current and sufficient for SaaS Operations/GOC support. * Clients and internal partners experience clear ownership, timely communication and effective resolution during onboarding. **Working arrangements** This is a client-facing role that may require participation in implementation windows, go-lives, Disaster Recovery exercises and critical issue resolution outside normal business hours. The analyst is expected to comply with CRD change, access, security, documentation and production-governance controls. Employees are expected to work from the office **4** days a week. ****About State Street**** **What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients. **Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential. **Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients.
